<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1054
Claimant:
Shannon Lewis
Adjuster:
Christopher Wong
27 Jun 2024
The insured reported that their vehicle was struck while they were turning left at an intersection, and the claimant
confirmed being a passenger in the vehicle at the time of impact. Initial documentation was opened and the claim was
assigned for review.
7 Jul 2024
Police and two independent witnesses confirmed the collision occurred as described, and scene photographs were
received showing damage consistent with a left-turn impact. The other driver's statement matches the insured's
account in its key points.
12 Oct 2024
The claimant reported a concussion following the collision and stated the same account of events in each
conversation so far. The injury description is consistent with the force of the crash based on the damage shown in the
photographs.
22 Oct 2024
Vehicle damage was inspected and is largely in line with the described impact. No prior damage to the vehicle is
known from the policy history or the inspection, and nothing indicates the damage predates the start of coverage.
6 Jan 2025
Medical records were requested. The treatment followed a typical course for this kind of injury, with care tapering as
the claimant's symptoms improved. No earlier injury to the same area of the body is known from the claimant's
history.
19 Jan 2025
The driver is listed as a named driver on the policy, and the policy was in force on the date of loss. The claimant's
presence in the vehicle has been confirmed by the police report and by witness statements.
30 Jan 2025
Based on the consistent accounts, photographs, and medical treatment pattern, the claim is progressing without
concerns about the reported injury or vehicle damage. The file will move to the next stage for settlement review.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
